Under Chinese Criminal Law, smuggling ordinary goods (走私普通货物罪) is a crime. The prosecution wants to charge with "走私普通货物罪". According to correction rules: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "走私普通货物". Also need to consider if any other crimes? Possibly "逃税" but that's part of smuggling. The facts mention tax evasion of 877.98 RMB, but that's minor. The criminal law article: Article 151 (走私普通货物、专用物品、技术、专用设备罪). So the crime is "走私普通货物". No other distinct offenses. So output single crime.
